summary: The 7-day solo Japan trip departing Raleigh-Durham (RDU) has moved from December 8–15, 2026 to March 2027. The exact March dates are not chosen yet. The trip now splits Tokyo and Osaka: 5 nights in Tokyo with Shibuya as the base, then 2 nights in Osaka, for 7 hotel nights total. Hotel budget is USD $150–200/night and the preferred style is upscale boutique. Interests: streetwear, sneaker and vintage shopping, Japanese food, and nightlife. User wakes around 11 AM–12 PM and wants only 1–2 touristy activities. Revised days: Day 1 arrive and settle in Shibuya; Day 2 Harajuku/Omotesando/Cat Street; Day 3 Shimokitazawa vintage; Day 4 Asakusa/Senso-ji plus Shibuya Sky and Shibuya sneaker shops; Day 5 Koenji vintage and food plus last Tokyo shopping; Day 6 Shinkansen to Osaka, then Amerikamura and Dotonbori; Day 7 Nakazakicho and Shinsaibashi, then Ura-Namba nightlife. The standalone sneaker day and the final Tokyo shopping day were merged into other Tokyo days to make room for Osaka. Suggested flights are open-jaw: fly into Tokyo (HND preferred, or NRT) and home from Osaka (KIX) to avoid backtracking. There are no nonstop RDU–Tokyo flights. The December flight research is stale for March and needs redoing: American Airlines showed RDU–Tokyo Dec 8–15 economy from $945 on one listing and $1,099 on another, and Expedia showed United RDU–NRT Dec 9–15 at $970. The December hotel quotes are also stale. Previous Shibuya hotel candidates: sequence MIYASHITA PARK (one-night Dec 8 quote about $170/night, $187 with taxes; 4-star, design-forward, rooftop bar, 3-min walk to Shibuya Metro Exit B1; 17:00 check-in, 14:00 checkout); Shibuya Granbell Hotel (about $118/night, $130 with taxes; design-oriented; 3-min walk to Shibuya Station; smaller rooms); Hotel Indigo Tokyo Shibuya (about $312/night, $348 with taxes; over budget). sequence MIYASHITA PARK is still the top Tokyo pick and Granbell the value backup, both now for 5 nights. An Osaka hotel is still needed. Late March is cherry blossom season, which can raise prices and crowds. Previous overall budget estimate was $2,655–$3,650 including a $300–600 shopping allowance; it needs to be re-estimated with the Osaka leg and Shinkansen. No bookings made.
